story.originalTitle: Why Mercedes thought Max Verstappen was "on some sort of massive bungee cord" in Azerbaijan GP
story.summaryEn: Data analysis showed that whenever George Russell built a gap through the tight middle sector, Max Verstappen closed in rapidly on the straights, leading Mercedes to describe him as being attached by a massive bungee cord.
detailZh: 为什么梅赛德斯认为马克斯·维斯塔潘在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上像“被某种巨大的弹力绳拴住”
数据解析显示，每当乔治·拉塞尔在狭窄的中段拉开差距，马克斯·维斯塔潘就会在直道上追近
马克斯·维斯塔潘（红牛车队）、乔治·拉塞尔（梅赛德斯）
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛的上半程，由于维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔驾驶的红牛难以超越奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦，拉塞尔得以将对身后车群的领先优势扩大到10秒以上。
当第31圈亚历克斯·阿尔本（阿尔本）的威廉姆斯赛车在5号弯撞上护墙卡住后，安全车出动，局面骤然改变。拉塞尔的优势随着安全车把车流聚拢而化为乌有，而维斯塔潘则在重启时抓住机会超越了皮亚斯特里。
从那时起，尽管拉塞尔在大部分收尾圈里保持着略微更快的速度，但他始终无法甩开维斯塔潘。最后一圈瓦尔特利·博塔斯在15号弯冲出赛道，拉塞尔减速遵守事故现场的黄旗时，他的涡轮失去了增压，这使得维斯塔潘再次咬住他的车尾，并在冲线前上演了一次惊险的猛扑。
令人惊讶的是，在大多数圈次中，拉塞尔在第二计时段都比维斯塔潘快得多——该计时段从5号弯的刹车区开始，环绕旧城墙的紧凑路段，一直延伸到16号弯的刹车区。但维斯塔潘都能在直道上立刻追回来，即使他在前一圈并未足够接近，因而无法获得超车模式所提供的额外半兆焦电能回收与释放。
梅赛德斯一级方程式车队副领队布拉德利·洛德（Bradley Lord）生动地描述了这一幕，他说：“就好像马克斯被一根巨大的弹力绳拴在后面一样。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘），红牛车队；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队。
冲线时拉塞尔仅落后维斯塔潘0.196秒，这使它成为世界锦标赛历史上最接近的完赛成绩之一——不过这一数据受影响，因为直到近几十年计时系统才变得精确，之前相对粗糙。
“在最后一圈，你可以把电池的电量从满用到空，这样就不必为了下一圈而让电池包保持平衡，”洛德（Lord）说。
“所以把它揣在兜里备用是好事，因为在那段双重黄旗区域，差距已经从一秒半缩小到半秒。拉塞尔的增压输出也稍微下降了一些，这种情况有时会在车速降得太低、发动机转速也随之下降时发生。”
“但事实并非如此，就好像维斯塔普被一根巨大的蹦极绳拴住了一样。拉塞尔每圈在中段都能实实在在地比他快半秒。而你看GPS数据轨迹，当尾流把维斯塔普重新拉回来时，那条线几乎瞬间变成了垂直状。
“所以如果要说什么的话，他（维斯塔普）在没有使用超车模式时反而似乎比使用时获得的优势更多，这相当反直觉。不过尽管在电视画面上看起来非常接近——当然镜头在一定程度上压缩了距离——但从未有过任何一刻他接近到可以尝试进攻或考虑完成一次超车。
“所以我认为拉塞尔完全掌控了局面，尽管只要出现一个微小的失误，结果可能就会大不相同。他完成了一场绝对精彩的比赛。他说（比赛早些时候）自己蹭到了墙，但实际上这么做反而让他赢得了时间。显然，他连这一点都判断得恰到好处。”
从第39圈安全车时段结束起，维斯塔普仅在第42、43、44和48圈比拉塞尔更快——其中第48圈只快了三毫秒。就整圈用时而言，两人之间的差距很少超过0.1秒，不过在倒数第二圈，拉塞尔快了0.183秒。
阿尔本的撞车改变了比赛的走向。
以第48圈为例，遥测数据显示，维斯塔潘在起步阶段实际上比拉塞尔快约0.1秒，原因是在2号弯到3号弯之间的直道上短暂地快了17公里/小时——这很可能是使用了更多电力输出的结果。但拉塞尔能够更晚松开油门，把梅赛德斯的操控优势转化为3号弯和4号弯更快的弯心速度，立刻逆转了差距。
在第二计时段，拉塞尔在弯道较多的路段将优势扩大到最高0.420秒：5号弯进弯更晚松油门，带来更高的弯心速度，然后在驶向7号弯的路段达到更高的峰值速度，尽管维斯塔潘使用了一些电力增强来获得6号弯更快的出弯。而当维斯塔潘在13号弯到14号弯之间的路段凭借更高的尾速追近时，梅赛德斯底盘更易驾驭的特质再次在15号弯发挥了作用，拉塞尔在那里能更晚松油门，把差距重新拉大到0.583秒。
维斯塔潘获得了更快的出弯，一点点蚕食差距，但梅赛德斯在16号弯再次更快，把差距缩小到0.541秒。从那以后，当他们通过侦测点、解锁下一圈的超车模式时，维斯塔潘迅速吞噬了差距，比拉塞尔更早换入最高挡位——是在18号弯之前而不是19号弯之后——并在该圈余下的路段取得了略高的尾速。
一旦进入直道本身，维斯塔潘一路到终点线都比对手快约11公里/小时，因此尽管他在单圈早段损失了半秒，总时间却只慢了0.003秒。红牛的内燃机是围场中最强大的，这也是它位居国际汽联额外开发与升级机会（ADUO）框架首位的原因，但作为整体套件，梅赛德斯的动力单元仍被认为更为出色。
尽管如此，虽然维斯塔潘和红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯都不愿透露得到福特支持的动力单元究竟发挥了多大作用，但使用同一套动力单元的小红牛车手阿维德·林德布拉德形容它为“一枚火箭”。
考虑到维斯塔潘在跟在拉塞尔尾流中时，在两个直线模式区域都享有如此大的速度优势，红牛赛车在主动空气动力学部署时很可能特别低阻——其他车队无疑会对此进行深入研究，抱以极大兴趣。
detailEn: Why Mercedes thought Max Verstappen was "on some sort of massive bungee cord" in Azerbaijan GP
Data analysis shows that every time George Russell pulled out a gap through the tight middle sector, Max Verstappen closed in on the straight
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

For the first half of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, George Russell was able to build a gap beyond 10 seconds to the chasing pack, as the Red Bulls of Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar struggled to pass Oscar Piastri's McLaren.

That picture altered abruptly when the safety car was deployed after Alex Albon's Williams became embedded in the wall at Turn 5 on lap 31. Russell's margin vanished as the safety car bunched up the field, and Verstappen seized the moment to pass Piastri at the restart.

From there, while Russell maintained marginally quicker for the majority of the closing laps, he was never able to shake Verstappen off. When Valtteri Bottas went off at Turn 15 on the final lap, Russell's turbo went off boost as he slowed to obey the yellow flags at the scene, enabling Verstappen to latch onto his tail again and set up a dramatic lunge to the tape.

What's remarkable is that on most laps, Russell was substantially faster than Verstappen through the second sector, which extends from the Turn 5 braking zone, around the tight section circumnavigating the old city walls, through to the Turn 16 braking zone. But Verstappen was able to come right back at him on the straight, even if he hadn't been close enough on the previous lap to access the extra half-megajoule of electrical harvesting and deployment granted by overtake mode.
Mercedes deputy Formula 1 team principal Bradley Lord described it in vivid terms, saying "it was like Max was on some sort of massive bungee cord".
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

Just 0.196s separated Russell from Verstappen at the line, making this one of the closest finishes in world championship history – although that statistic is skewed by the relative crudeness of the timing systems until recent decades.
"On the last lap you can drain the battery from top to bottom so you don't have to keep the [battery] pack balanced for the following lap," said Lord.

"And so it was good we had that in the pocket because the gap had gone from a second and a half to half a second through that double yellow. George dropped off the boost slightly as well, which sometimes can happen when the car speed drops too low and the engine speed does as well.

"But no, it was like Max was on some sort of massive bungee cord. George would literally put half a second on him every lap through the middle sector. And you look at the GPS trace and suddenly it almost goes vertical as the tow pulls Max back in.

"So if anything it almost seemed he [Verstappen] was gaining more without overtake mode than with, which was quite counterintuitive. But even though it looked very close on the TV pictures and obviously they foreshortened things a little bit, there wasn't any point where he was close enough to make an attempt or to contemplate an overtake.

"So I think George had it all under control, albeit one tiny mistake and it could have looked pretty different. Just an absolutely fantastic job from him. He said he'd brushed the wall, [earlier in the race] but he actually gained time doing it. So clearly he judged even that perfectly."

From the end of the safety car period on lap 39, Verstappen was only quicker than Russell on laps 42, 43, 44 and 48 – the latter by three milliseconds. In terms of overall laptime they were rarely separated by more than a tenth, although Russell was 0.183s quicker on the penultimate lap.
Albon's shunt changed the direction of the race

Taking lap 48 as an example, the telemetry data indicates Verstappen was actually around a tenth of a second up on Russell early on, by dint of briefly being 17km/h faster on the stretch between Turns 2 and 3 – likely a factor of using more electrical deployment. But Russell was able to get off the throttle later and parlay the Mercedes' handling advantage into faster apex speeds at Turn 3 and 4, immediately inverting the deficit.

Through the second sector, Russell built his advantage to a peak of 0.420s through the twistier sections: later off the throttle into Turn 5, giving a higher apex speed, then hitting a higher peak speed on the run to Turn 7 even though Verstappen used some boost to gain a faster initial exit from Turn 6. And while Verstappen came back at him through the stretch between Turns 13 and 14, with a higher top speed, again the Mercedes' more biddable chassis made the difference at Turn 15, where Russell was able to dethrottle much later and pull the gap back to 0.583s.

Verstappen got a quicker exit, nibbling away at the gap, but again the Merc was quicker through Turn 16, taking the gap to 0.541s. From there onwards, as they passed the detection point unlocking overtake mode for the following lap. Verstappen simply ate up the gap, changing to top gear much earlier than Russell – before Turn 18 rather than after Turn 19 – and attaining a slightly higher top speed for the remainder of the lap.

Once on the straight itself, Verstappen was around 11km/h faster all the way to the line, hence his total time being just 0.003s slower despite losing half a second earlier in the lap. The Red Bull internal combustion engine is the most powerful on the grid, hence its position atop the FIA's Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) framework, but as a package the Mercedes PU is still believed to be superior.

Still, while Verstappen and Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies would not be drawn on how significant a role the Ford-backed PU made, Arvid Lindblad, whose VCARB uses the same unit, described it as "a rocketship".

Given how much of a speed advantage Verstappen enjoyed in both straightline mode zones when in Russell's tow, it's likely the Red Bull is particularly slippery when its active aerodynamics are deployed – something other teams will no doubt be examining with great interest.

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿的巴西大奖赛帽子揭幕，发布日期确认
法拉利为刘易斯·汉密尔顿揭幕了一款特别的巴西主题帽子，他将佩戴这款帽子参加2026年的巴西大奖赛
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1车队新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
法拉利揭幕了一款巴西主题帽子，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中佩戴，粉丝们可以在比赛前几天购买自己的帽子。
Maranello车队与Puma在10月16日通过Instagram联合发布了这款帽子。"莱维斯将在Interlagos赛道上戴上带着一小块巴西元素的帽子。而且它很快也将属于你。将于11月3日开始发售，"车队在展示七届冠军戴着新设计的帽子的照片时写道。
这款帽子以大胆的黄色为主题，细节处有磨损效果，露出下面的绿色，反映了巴西国旗的颜色。法拉利标志以银色突出地放置在前面，与银色的Puma标志相匹配，缝制在帽檐右侧。
"给我来一顶吧，莱维斯先生，"一位粉丝评论道，另一位粉丝补充说："我甚至不是法拉利的粉丝，但这真的很酷。我也想戴。"
其他人质疑这款帽子是否是法拉利车手将在Interlagos赛事中引入类似特殊头盔的信号。
汉密尔顿于2022年11月正式成为巴西的荣誉公民。
"我想对在这里的每一个人说声大大的谢谢，对于那些为了让这一天成为可能而搬山填海的人，" 41岁的汉密尔顿当时说。"这对我来说真的是一种巨大的荣誉，能够在这里接受和接受这个公民身份。我真的感觉现在我是你们中的一员，终于。
"当我2007年第一次来到这里[汉密尔顿的第一个F1赛季]，这里的爱是如何增长的，我们共同的经历，尤其是2021年[他向胜利发起冲击]，知道你们一直在我身后为我加油，这是我一生中最特别的时刻之一。我迫不及待地想要继续努力向前。
"我真的很想将今天，这个荣誉，献给埃尔顿·塞纳——献给埃尔顿的家庭，他的朋友和他的粉丝。对我来说，当我五岁的时候，我第一次看到埃尔顿赛车，那就是我知道我想要成为世界冠军，就像他一样。
“那时我才知道并了解了巴西。那时我开始以巴西队的身份玩FIFA！但实际上，通过他的眼睛，我看到了巴西人有多么热情，这种热爱和激情有多深，你对国家的热爱有多么美好。我非常兴奋能在这里多待一些时间。”
2026年巴西大奖赛将于11月6日至8日举行，这将是一个三连赛的一部分，从10月23日至25日的美国大奖赛开始，接着是10月30日至11月1日的墨西哥大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
Ferrari has unveiled a special Brazil-themed cap for Lewis Hamilton to wear at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has revealed a Brazil-themed cap that Lewis Hamilton will wear at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and fans will be able to buy their own a few days before the race.

The Maranello outfit announced the cap in a joint Instagram post with Puma on 16 October. "Lewis will be wearing a small piece of Brazil with him at Interlagos. And it can also be yours soon. Available to buy on November 3rd," the team wrote alongside photos of the seven-time champion wearing the new design.

The cap features a bold yellow theme with distressed detailing that reveals green underneath, reflecting the colours of the Brazilian flag. The Ferrari logo is prominently placed on the front in silver, with a matching silver Puma logo embroidered on the front right of the bill.
"Give me one right now, Sir Lewis Hamilton," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm not even a Ferrari fan, but that is slick. I'd wear it."
Others questioned whether the cap could be a sign that the Ferrari driver will introduce a similar special helmet for the race at Interlagos.
Hamilton officially became an honorary citizen of Brazil in November 2022.

"I’d like to say a big, big thank you to everyone here at the house, for all those who’ve moved mountains to make this day possible," the 41-year-old said at the time. "It is honestly the greatest honour for me to be here receiving and accepting this citizenship. I really do feel like now I’m one of you, finally.

"When I arrived here in 2007 [Hamilton’s first F1 season], the love that’s grown, the experiences we’ve had and, particularly 2021 [his charge to victory], knowing you guys were cheering me on the way, it was one of the most special moments of my entire life. I can’t wait for us to continue to strive ahead.

"I really want to dedicate today, this honour, to Ayrton Senna – to Ayrton’s family, to his friends and to his fans. For me, when I was five years old, I saw Ayrton race for the first time, and that was the moment I knew that I wanted to be a world champion, just like him.

"It was then that I knew and learnt about Brazil. It was then that I started to play FIFA as Brazil! But really, through his eyes, I was able to see how passionate Brazilians were, and how deep it goes, the love and passion you have for your country, and how beautiful it is. I’m so excited to spend some more time here."

The 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is scheduled for 6-8 November and will round out a triple-header starting with the United States Grand Prix from 23-25 October followed by the Mexican Grand Prix from 30 October to 1 November.

detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.

detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1以全新汤米·希尔费格系列在美国大奖赛上尽显得克萨斯风情
凯迪拉克与汤米·希尔费格发布了一个以得克萨斯为灵感的五件式牛仔（denim）系列
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——图片由汤米·希尔费格提供
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队及其合作伙伴汤米·希尔费格在奥斯汀美国大奖赛前发布了一个德克萨斯主题的服装系列，这让我们所有人都兴奋不已。
汤米·希尔费格与凯迪拉克一级方程式车队的奥斯汀系列于本周二早些时候开售。但这并不是这两个品牌第一次推出与比赛相关的产品。他们已经在同一城市系列中推出了迈阿密和墨西哥系列，并且还计划在11月推出拉斯维加斯系列。
不出意外的话，牛仔布是这些单品的核心，它们带有镀铬细节和汤米·希尔费格红白蓝配色的V形美国国旗。
男士可以购买基于经典卡车司机风格的浅色水洗牛仔夹克。女士则有一件带银色箔涂层的牛仔背心。一件T恤、一件背心和一顶牛仔帽让这个系列更加让人难以拒绝。你知道还有什么同样让人难以拒绝吗？可以看到凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯在日落时分向镜头举起一顶牛仔帽，背上印有V形旗帜图案。
你还需要什么来说服你？
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——由汤米·希尔费格提供
“在我们的美国根源上增添一点乐趣”
汤米·希尔费格首席设计官李·霍尔曼表示，设计师们从该品牌最受欢迎的两件单品入手。
他说：“我们从 Tommy 衣橱中的标志性单品——牛仔夹克和白 T 恤——入手，并研究了如何以奥斯汀的城市气质为灵感对它们进行重新演绎。”
“关键在于把熟悉的单品赋予全新的视角，同时坚守我们经典美式酷感的品牌基因。”
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队首席品牌顾问卡西迪·托里斯表示，在得克萨斯州举行的这场比赛让两个品牌都有了发挥空间。
“奥斯汀让我们有机会在美国根源上玩得更尽兴一些，”托里斯说，“这是为比赛周末打造的粉丝服饰，但设计上力求在围场之外也能长久穿着。”
汤米·希尔费格是凯迪拉克的官方服装和车迷服饰合作伙伴，车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯——博塔斯的队友——也是该品牌的全球男装大使。奥斯汀站是美国车队本赛季继五月初迈阿密大奖赛之后的第二个主场比赛，佩雷斯期待能在离家更近的地方驾驶。
“我们距离能够与前车竞争还差大约一秒到一秒半，我认为我们现在真正需要的是一辆更强的赛车，”佩雷斯在新加坡站后表示。“其他一切都在按预期推进，我相信我们作为一个团队会达到目标。我非常期待奥斯汀和墨西哥，我们的两场主场比赛。
“奥斯汀是车队的主场，墨西哥对我而言将格外特别，在家乡观众面前比赛并迎来第300场大奖赛。那将是一个非常特别的周末。”
凯迪拉克在首个赛季仍在等待它的首个积分。
detailEn: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
Cadillac and Tommy Hilfiger have unveiled a five-piece denim collection inspired by Texas
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix in Austin, and it's making us all kinds of excited.

The Tommy Hilfiger x Cadillac Formula 1 Team Austin collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week. But this isn't the first time the two brands have released something in connection with a race. They have already released Miami and Mexico collections in the same city series, and a Las Vegas drop is also planned for November.
Denim, maybe unsurprisingly, is the heart of these pieces, which carry chrome detailing and a chevron-shaped American flag in Tommy Hilfiger's red, white and blue.

Men can buy a light-wash denim jacket based on the classic trucker style. For women, there's a denim vest with a silver foil coating. A T-shirt, a tank top and a denim cap make the range even harder to say no to. And do you know what else does the same? Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas can be seen tipping a cowboy hat to the camera at sunset, with the chevron flag design across his back.
What more do you need to persuade you?
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
"A little more fun with our American roots"
Lee Holman, Tommy Hilfiger's chief design officer, said the designers started with two of the brand's most popular pieces.
"We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe – the denim jacket and the white T-shirt – and looked at how we could rework them inspired by the character of Austin," he said.
"It's about taking familiar pieces and giving them a fresh point of view, while staying grounded in our classic American cool DNA."
Cassidy Towriss, chief brand adviser for the Cadillac Formula 1 Team, said the race in Texas gave both brands room to play.
"Austin gives us a chance to have a little more fun with our American roots," Towriss said. "It's fanwear made for race weekend, but designed to live well beyond the paddock."

Tommy Hilfiger is Cadillac's official apparel and fanwear partner, with driver Sergio Perez, Bottas's team-mate, also the brand's global menswear ambassador. With the Austin race being the American team's second home race of the season after the Miami Grand Prix earlier this season in early May, Perez is looking forward to driving a little closer to home.

“We are still lacking around one to one-and-a-half seconds to be able to compete with the cars ahead, and I think what we really need now is a stronger car underneath us," Perez said following his Singapore campaign. "Everything else has been progressing as expected, and I’m confident we will get there as a team. I’m really looking forward to Austin and Mexico, our two home races.
"Austin for the team, and Mexico will be particularly special for me, racing in front of my home crowd and reaching 300 grands prix. It’s going to be a very special weekend.”
Cadillac is still waiting for its first points in its debut season.
